description:
You are an energy auditor tasked with implementing a facility-wide retrofit in the '4StoreyBuilding' eQUEST model. The project involves duct sealing to reduce fan static pressure and optimizing heating supply temperatures for new condensing furnaces.

Your goal is to update ALL 15 Packaged Single-Zone (PSZ) HVAC systems in the building (Ground, Middle, and Top floors) with the following parameters:
1. SUPPLY-STATIC: Change to 2.0 in. w.g. (reflecting tighter ducts)
2. MAX-SUPPLY-T: Change to 100°F (optimizing for condensing efficiency)

The systems are located in the 'Air-Side HVAC' module. You must modify these parameters for every system on the Ground Floor (G.*), Middle Floor (M.*), and Top Floor (T.*). There are 5 systems per floor.

After making the changes, you must run the 'Simulate Building Performance' action to generate new results, and then Save the project.
